parameters.name: level
parameters.description: The packaging level, lowest first EACH < INNER < CASE < PALLET.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-chosen key. A repeat on the same route with the same key and the same request replays the first response; the same key with another body is 422 idempotency-key-reused. Keys are kept for 24 hours.
